feeds.title: Arabic Food Recipes
feeds.description: Looking for Arabic food recipes and ideas. Explore the taste of Arab cuisine including cooking tips at arabic-food.blogspot.com.

feeds.title: Maureen Abood
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Maureen Abood. I write about my Lebanese family, food, and life up north in Michigan on my blog. Rose Water & Orange Blossoms CookBook. Come read, cook, and eat with me.

feeds.title: Feast in the Middle East
feeds.description: Feast in the Middle East gives you easy to follow explanations about the cuisine, techniques, and easy to find ingredients that will help you wow your friends and family with delicious meals.

feeds.title: Zaatar & Zaytoun
feeds.description: Lebanese recipes and how to make them including traditional, modern and regional classics as well as secret family recipes.

feeds.title: Beirutista
feeds.description: Beirutista is an internationally renowned, award-winning blog that treats the cultural and lifestyle nuances in Lebanon as seen through the author's multicultural lens. Topics range from analysis and humor pieces to restaurant reviews, foodie discoveries, rants and raves, travel guides, general news, views, and memoirs.

feeds.title: UMAMIMAMI
feeds.description: Explore a vast collection of Middle Eastern and seasonal recipes. From kitchen classics to sweet treats, these recipes are easy to follow and feature organic, sustainable ingredients and whole foods. Whether you're looking for a family-friendly dinner idea or a show-stopping dessert, Dyala Madani's UMAMIMAMI has got you covered.

feeds.title: Sweet Pillar Food Blog
feeds.description: Nadia and Deana create modern Middle Eastern recipes handed down from their families to yours. Plus, they create quick, easy & delicious meals for busy moms and people on the go! Always with the most beautiful photography and tablescape design.

feeds.title: Aladdin Cafe Blog
feeds.description: Taste the exotic flavors of the middle east and get to know more about Mediterranean cuisine, plenty of healthy, scrumptious salads, vegetarian meals with Mediterranean flavors, melt in mouth shish kababs and delicious appetizers like hummus, tabouleh, falafel, stuffed grape leaves and more.

feeds.title: Orange Blossom Water
feeds.description: My name is Dimah. I'm from Syria. Most of my posts are about Syrian cuisine, I'm sharing with you dishes and techniques that you will never find in cookbooks because Syrians learn recipes from their mothers and grandmothers not from books or chefs.

feeds.title: One Arab Vegan Blog
feeds.description: Hi! I'm Nada. I create simple, healthy, plant-based recipes inspired by Middle Eastern flavors and write about leading a vegan lifestyle in the Arab world.

feeds.title: Bethany Kehdy
feeds.description: I aim to try to demystify Middle Eastern food and make it more accessible. I want to change perceptions that Middle Eastern food is complicated and laborious and get more people grappling their fear of the unknown with the cuisine. I like to cook both classical and Middle Eastern-inspired dishes and try to always present them in an un-intimidating manner with easy to follow instructions.

feeds.title: Fufu's Kitchen
feeds.description: Fufu's Kitchen is a food blog that shares delicious and quick recipes that you are sure to enjoy! You don't have to be a professional chef or spend hours in the kitchen to enjoy amazing tastes from around the world. I'll show you how quick and easy it is to make your favorite dishes at home.

feeds.title: Chef in disguise
feeds.description: Sawsan is the Chef in Disguise that shares easy authentic middle eastern recipes along with family favorites from around the globe. You will also get a taste of life in the middle east, the culture, and the famous landmarks.
